name: @rrock-k/loopkit
description: Portable feedback runtime for self-describing HTML artifacts.

scripts.check: npm run build && node --check src/loopkit.js && node --check dist/loopkit.js && node --check scripts/build.mjs && node --check scripts/validate.mjs && node --check scripts/build-standalone.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run validate -- examples/basic.html && npm run standalone -- examples/basic.html examples/basic.generated.standalone.html && npm run validate -- examples/basic.generated.standalone.html
